result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (around lines 393–394). The existing `Scoping*Test` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I did not add new tests or check the new cases (plain `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock-größe`) by running them.

- **Rules:** `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` is now `.*/__mock[^/]*/.*`, and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` is now `.*/mock[^/]*/.*`.
- **Folder names:** The old rules needed at least one ASCII letter, digit, underscore, hyphen or space after `mock`. They now accept any folder name starting with `mock` or `__mock`, including plain `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟`.
- **Single folder only:** `[^/]*` keeps the match inside one folder name. `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, and files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` are not matched.
- **Previous matches:** `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already converts `\` to `/` before matching, so Windows-style paths work with no extra change.

I did not commit.
